chunks: Muḥammad ibn Yaḥyā, from Salamah ibn al-Khaṭṭāb, from ʿAlī ibn Sayf, from Abī al-Maghrāʾ, from ʿUqbah ibn Bashīr, from Abū Jaʿfar (عليه السلام), who said:
The Prophet (صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم) said to ʿAlī (عليه السلام): “O ʿAlī, bury me in this place, raise my grave from the ground by four fingers, and sprinkle water upon it.”

key_terms.أَرْبَعَ أَصَابِعَ: Four fingers; the measure for raising the grave above the ground.
key_terms.ادْفِنِّي: Bury me; a direct instruction regarding burial.
key_terms.الْمَاءِ: Water; used here for sprinkling over the grave.
key_terms.قَبْرِي: My grave; referring to the grave of the Prophet (صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم).
key_terms.هَذَا الْمَكَانِ: This place; the specified location of burial.

ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet (صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم) instruct Imam ʿAlī (عليه السلام) regarding his burial and grave?
ai.summary: This hadith relates the Prophet’s (صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم) instruction to Imam ʿAlī (عليه السلام) concerning his burial place and the manner of preparing his grave. It indicates the grave should be slightly raised above the ground and water sprinkled over it, reflecting practices connected to burial in the sunnah (prophetic tradition).

en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Salma Bin Al Khattab, from Ali Bin Sayf, from Abu Al Magra’a, from Uqba Bin Bashir, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘The Prophet<sup>saww</sup> said to Ali<sup>asws</sup>: ‘O Ali<sup>asws</sup>! Bury me<sup>saww</sup> in this place, and raise my<sup>saww</sup> grave from the ground by four fingers, and sprinkle upon it from the water’.
en.sarwar: 35. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from from Salma ibn al-Khattab from Ali ibn Sayf from abu al-Maghra’ from ‘Uqba ibn Bashir from abu Ja‘far (a.s.) who has said the following.
“The Holy Prophet (s.a) said to Ali (a.s.), O Ali, bury me in this place, raise the surface of my grave from the ground by the width of four fingers and sprinkle water on it.”
